_comment: Hand-curated reasons for repos absent from The Stack v3 train set, keyed by repo slug. scripts/stack_check.rb writes the observed facts to data/stack.json and never touches this file; this file records WHY when the reason took human digging (opt-out issues, private-until dates). A repo missing from both files' explanations renders as 'not in the set, reason not established', never as a guessed cause.

rspec/rspec.github.io.note: The rspec org opted out of The Stack; the whole org is absent from v3.

bridgetownrb/bridgetown.note: The bridgetownrb org opted out of The Stack; the whole org is absent from v3.

ruby/ruby.note: 170 other ruby-org repos are in the v3 train set, ruby/ruby is not, and no opt-out is on record. The Ruby License is not on the Blue Oak permissive list, so file-level license filtering is the plausible cause, but the pipeline's actual decision is not observable from outside.

basecamp/fizzy.note: Public since 2025-12-02, after the v3 crawl cutoff of 2025-08-07. The GitHub created_at (2024-06-21) predates the cutoff because the repo existed privately; a private repo is invisible to the crawl.
